relationships.subject: DAFM/chitosan-1 hydrogel
relationships.evidence_quote: the expression of metalloproteinase-9 (MMP-9) and IL-6 was lower on the DAFM/chitosan-1 hydrogel compared with the DAFM/chitosan-2 hydrogel

key_findings: AFSCs on DAFM/chitosan-1 hydrogel showed higher Col-I/Col-II/aggrecan and lower MMP-9 and IL-6 than on hydrogel-2
Both hydrogels partially repaired AF defects in rat tail
